say: After the climb, the pipe leads to five new puzzle levels.
In the first level, a crystal unlocks copying, and copies can be placed on squares with a turquoise border.
Copies move together, so one copy holds a plate down while the other walks across the bridge it opens.
In the second level, the two lanes have gaps in different places, so the jump has to be timed for both runners.
The third level adds cutting, which moves a runner onto an orange ring.
The fourth level needs three runners on three plates at the same time, using both copy and cut.
In the last level, the runner throws his head over a wall and rolls it under a barrier.
